proof_body:
by
  intro R _ _ e he
  have h0 : e * (1 - e) = 0 := by rw [mul_sub, mul_one, he, sub_self]
  rcases IsLocalRing.isUnit_or_isUnit_one_sub_self e with h | h
  · right
    have := h.mul_right_eq_zero.mp h0
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp this).symm
  · left
    exact h.mul_left_eq_zero.mp h0
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (e : R), e * e = e → e = 0 ∨ e = 1
